events.verdict: Oladipo (IND) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Ingram (NOP).
Ingram (NOP) makes marginal contact to Brogdon's (IND) body during his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Adams (NOP) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Brogdon (IND) when he firms up and absorbs the contact.
Oladipo (IND) makes incidental contact with Williamson (NOP) during the rebound.
Turner (IND) makes contact to Williamson's (NOP) arm/elbow during his shooting motion that disrupts his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Holiday (IND) places a hand/arm to the front of Ingram (NOP) during the drive but the contact marginal.
Adams (NOP) makes marginal contact with Turner (IND) as they position themselves for the rebound.
McDermott (IND) closes out and makes some contact with Redick's (NOP) body as he attempts to dribble out of the corner.
Oladipo (IND) maintains a legal guarding position on Ball (NOP) and cleanly steals the ball.
Turner (IND) trips McDermott (IND) during the screen.
Turner (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Ball (NOP) when he firms up and absorbs the contact.
Oladipo (IND) goes to not through Bledsoe (NOP) on the perimeter.
Turner (IND) makes contact to Williamson's (NOP) lower body during his driving shot attempt.
Sampson (IND) jumps vertically and maintains a legal vertical position while contesting the driving shot attempt by Ingram (NOP).
Sampson (IND) pulls Adams' (NOP) hand off ball during the rebound.
Adams (NOP) establishes position and cleanly deflects the ball as Oladipo (IND) attempts to split the defenders. Oladipo and Adams make incidental knee to knee contact on the sequence.
Sampson (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Ball (NOP) when he firms up and absorbs the contact.
McDermott (IND) makes brief contact to Ball's (NOP) body while defending in transition.
